font-weight: normal;">Standardised templates extend system-sourced financial profiles while preserving dimensional integrity, traceability and reusable ingestion logic</font></div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="1194.5" width="1000" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="4" parent="2" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=#666666;fillColor=#f5f5f5;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;rounded=0;fontSize=18;spacing=5;fontColor=#333333;glass=0;shadow=0;spacingTop=10;spacingRight=10;" value="<font style="font-size: 12px;"><b>How it Works</b></font><div><ul style="padding-left: 20px; margin-top: 5px;"><li><span style="background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(51, 51, 51), rgb(193, 193, 193)); font-size: 12px;">Each approved workbook is registered from the controlled SharePoint folder and assigned a surrogate Financial Entity key.&nbsp;</span></li><li><span style="background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(51, 51, 51), rgb(193, 193, 193)); font-size: 12px;">A reusable Power Query function extracts and standardises the financial profile, while a second function extracts controlled metadata from defined workbook names.</span></li><li><span style="background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(51, 51, 51), rgb(193, 193, 193)); font-size: 12px;">The profile is transformed to the same transaction schema as SAP-sourced data, while the metadata is aligned and appended to the Financial Entity dimension.&nbsp;</span></li><li><span style="background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(51, 51, 51), rgb(193, 193, 193)); font-size: 12px;">Both are then processed through the same downstream mapping and scenario logic as system-sourced records.</span></li></ul></div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="420" width="260" x="370.0000000000002" y="512" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <UserObject label="SME / User Inputs" mermaidId="n:USER" mermaidBaseStyle="html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeWidth=1;fillColor=light-dark(#ECECFF,#1f2020);strokeColor=light-dark(#9370DB,#cccccc);fontColor=light-dark(#333333,#cccccc);fontFamily=Trebuchet MS,Verdana,Arial,sans-serif;fontSize=16;" mermaidBaseValue="SME / User Inputs" id="5"> <mxCell parent="2" style="html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeWidth=1;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=14;spacingRight=0;spacing=10;align=center;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="44.239528795811516" width="200" x="399" y="79.5" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> <mxCell id="6" edge="1" parent="2" source="7" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;" target="8" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <UserObject label="<div>Standardised Manual Input Template</div><div>Excel / SharePoint</div>" mermaidId="n:HELPER" mermaidBaseStyle="html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeWidth=1;fillColor=light-dark(#ECECFF,#1f2020);strokeColor=light-dark(#9370DB,#cccccc);fontColor=light-dark(#333333,#cccccc);fontFamily=Trebuchet MS,Verdana,Arial,sans-serif;fontSize=16;" mermaidBaseValue="Controlled Account Aggregation Schedule

div.span: Standardised templates extend system-sourced financial profiles while preserving dimensional integrity, traceability and reusable ingestion logic

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 242px; height: 1px; padding-top: 727px; margin-left: 375px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #333333;
display: inline-block; font-size: 18px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#333333, #c1c1c1); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

span.style: background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(51, 51, 51), rgb(193, 193, 193)); font-size: 12px;

li.span: Each approved workbook is registered from the controlled SharePoint folder and assigned a surrogate Financial Entity key.

span.style: background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(51, 51, 51), rgb(193, 193, 193)); font-size: 12px;

li.span: A reusable Power Query function extracts and standardises the financial profile, while a second function extracts controlled metadata from defined workbook names.

span.style: background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(51, 51, 51), rgb(193, 193, 193)); font-size: 12px;

li.span: The profile is transformed to the same transaction schema as SAP-sourced data, while the metadata is aligned and appended to the Financial Entity dimension.

span.style: background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(51, 51, 51), rgb(193, 193, 193)); font-size: 12px;

li.span: Both are then processed through the same downstream mapping and scenario logic as system-sourced records.

li.span: Controlled metadata: reference attributes are restricted to valid enterprise dimension values
Surrogate identity: non-system profiles receive controlled unique Financial Entity keys
Standardised schema: manual profiles follow the same downstream structure as system-sourced data
Source traceability: manual records remain identifiable from their point of origin

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 242, 204), rgb(40, 29, 0)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

display: inline-block; font-size: 13px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

li.span: Data quality by design: controlled inputs and validation reduce inconsistent classifications
Governed extensibility: additional approved manual profiles can be integrated without redesigning the pipeline
Reusable ingestion: common transformation logic supports consistent processing across files
Seamless integration: manual and system profiles enter the same modelling framework
